_metadata.description: AnSA NemoClaw PoC - Camera Detection Events

events.notes: Subject detected at departure hall security checkpoint. Moving towards Gate B3.
Unattended bag detected near main entrance. Bag remained stationary for 12 minutes. Security dispatched.
Low-confidence match against watchlist. Subject partially obscured by market crowd. Manual review recommended.

events.location: Aso Rock Villa, Outer Perimeter Gate
events.notes: Unregistered vehicle attempted access at outer perimeter. Vehicle turned around after checkpoint query. Plate flagged in stolen vehicle database.
Watchlist match at legislative building entrance. Subject was in a group of five individuals. Gate security notified for manual verification.

events.location: Zuba Expressway Toll Gate, Abuja-Kaduna Highway
events.notes: Vehicle flagged on BOLO list. Traveling northbound at approximately 120km/h. Alert forwarded to Kaduna State command.

events.location: Central Bank of Nigeria, Headquarters, Abuja
events.notes: Loitering pattern detected. Individual circled perimeter three times within 45-minute window. Behaviour flagged for review.
Second detection of same subject. Higher confidence — clearer angle obtained at boarding gate area. Subject appears to be awaiting flight departure.
Watchlist match at mall entrance. Subject entered via parking level B2. Carrying large duffel bag. Mall security alerted.
Vehicle associated with POI-4162 detected heading towards Suleja. Checkpoint officers alerted. Vehicle occupants: 3 males.
